decision: Leave ab-front off. On the locked validation seeds the paired score against 528ab204 is -0.0278 and the interval includes 0. The A+B gain from 8410-8412 is not kept. No parameter was changed after the 8420-8422 games.
what: ab-front keeps A's front-slot coverage at the root only, and does not evict a front the incoming card raids onto. Its evidence gate runs only on preferEnergyGenerator, before confirmed choices: our main phase, nothing pending, the search chose a front, and that preference rewrote the same card onto its energy line or onto next. A same-boundary energy line that scores at least as high still replaces the front. Confirmed wins and immediate losses stay protected. Start-phase draws, the filter chain, moves, discards and triggers are not gated. Full A, B and A+B stay available as historical comparisons. A's coverage weights are unchanged.
limit: A later confirmed choice can still replace a searched front with a different card's energy line. At the three-AP snapshot, 48 nodes, A and ab-front search the 4000 front (score 18.85) and then play the 1500 energy. Full A+B keeps the 4000. Gating that final choice undoes the filter chain, so ab-front does not.
